description: FY2027 annual operating plan and budget approval deck for a branded food manufacturer.
provenance: Modeled on annual board budget materials for consumer packaged goods companies: planning assumptions, P&L targets, investment envelope, category growth, sensitivity cases, cash allocation, and formal approval. Deliberately exercises an eight-slide deck with a stacked area chart using areaGrouping, four financial KPIs, and plan-versus-prior comparisons.

content.title: The FY2027 plan funds growth while expanding margin.
content.subtitle: Management recommendation
prose: Organic sales growth of 4.6% combines 2.1% volume/mix and 2.5% pricing.
Procurement and network utilization expand adjusted EBITDA margin by 60 bps.
Marketing and capital gates can protect $38M of cash in the downside case.

content.title: Investment envelope and stage gates
content.subtitle: $172M capital plan and $31M incremental operating investment
bulletPoints: $68M — Cedar Rapids refrigerated line; board-approved gate in March after customer commitments reach 70% of capacity
$34M — packaging automation across four meals-and-sauces plants; payback 2.8 years from labor and material yield
$27M — enterprise demand-planning and trade-promotion platform; phased by business unit through Q2 FY2028
$21M — food safety, maintenance, and regulatory capital with no deferrable portion
$22M — warehouse and network projects, including exit from two overflow facilities by September 2027
$31M operating investment — brand media, e-commerce content, category management, and innovation resources

content.title: Sensitivity and management triggers
content.subtitle: Protecting cash and covenant headroom under adverse scenarios
bulletPoints: Base case: 4.6% organic growth and 16.0% EBITDA margin produce year-end net leverage of 2.1x
Commodity downside: 6.0% input inflation reduces EBITDA by $47M before pricing and productivity actions
Volume downside: 2% retailer destocking reduces EBITDA by $31M and increases year-end inventory by $18M
Combined downside: pause $17M of media and $21M of uncommitted capital to keep net leverage below 2.6x
Upside: refrigerated velocity 5% above plan adds $24M EBITDA but advances second-shift hiring by one quarter
Monthly trigger: management action required if trailing-eight-week shipments fall 3% below plan or cash conversion falls below 55%

content.title: Approve the FY2027 plan, capital envelope, and incentives.
content.subtitle: Board vote under agenda item 6
prose: Cedar Rapids requires separate approval above $72M of expected spend.
Management also returns if contracted capacity remains below the 70% gate.
